verdict.rationale: Salesmate documents publicly available RESTful APIs and a platform that manages contacts and companies, so an external agent could plausibly create and update lead records through its API. However, the evidence never shows specific endpoints for creating records, filling company data or assigning owners, never mentions an MCP server, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: an MCP server, documented create-contact/company endpoints, company-data enrichment, owner-assignment via API, a machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner

citations.quote: Access to publicly available RESTful APIs
Manage contacts, companies, deals, pipelines, activities, and conversations in one place.
Update CRM records, fields, and activities autonomously without manual intervention
